records.note: 《Stranger》六人录音／发行阵容。成员本人采访确认此动画 MV 中没有成员真人出镜；照片仅供辨认演唱者，仅保留 MV 评分，不生成成员评分。
records.evidence: The release-specific direct interview names six members and explicitly links its Korean version to 9qRmlYPJB10. These are the recording/release lineup, not live-action MV cast.

records.label: 公开发行阵容
records.note: 2022年日本专辑《ドキドキLOVE》发行阵容，含当时成员 JURI；不改变其现已离团的状态。 仅为本次发行／项目的公开署名，不表示逐人 MV 出镜已核实，也不生成个人评分。
records.evidence: Yoshimoto label release names the six members including Juri and identifies the album/title song; the exact official Japan-channel video metadata identifies this same album title track and October 5 release. Nikkan Sports release-day interview corroborates the six-member lineup.
